facebook.caption:
This place fixes burnout faster than any beach bar.

Chùa Hưng Sơn sits quietly in Khu Phố 7, away from the resort strip. No crowds. No entry fee. Just incense, still air, and the kind of silence Phu Quoc doesn't advertise.

4.8 stars from people who actually found it. Go early morning for the full effect.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walk through the gates of Chùa Hưng Sơn and the noise stops. Watch what happens to your shoulders in the first 30 seconds. Phu Quoc has more than beaches.
